description: Check whether a single domain is available for registration and what it costs. Returns availability (`avail: yes|no`), registration price, renewal price, transfer price, and (for premium domains) extended pricing details. Pricing is in USD. Use this BEFORE register_domain to confirm cost — Porkbun rejects registrations whose `cost_cents` doesn't match the current quote. **Checking more than one name? Use `check_domains` instead** — it takes up to 25 in a single call and draws on a separate, more generous budget (200 domains/minute against 10 checks/10s here), because Porkbun chunks checks per registry and a batch costs less than the same names one at a time.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to check, e.g. `example.com`

name: check_domain
title: Check Domain
